mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Inventory_History (book_id, employee_id, change_qty, reason, created_at) VALUES (#{book_id}, #{employee_id}, #{change_qty}, #{reason}, SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT h.history_id, h.book_id, h.employee_id, h.change_qty, h.reason, h.created_at, b.title AS book_title, b.isbn, e.name AS employee_name FROM Inventory_History h JOIN Book b ON h.book_id = b.book_id LEFT JOIN Employee e ON h.employee_id = e.employee_id ORDER BY h.history_id DESC

SELECT h.history_id, h.book_id, h.employee_id, h.change_qty, h.reason, h.created_at, b.title AS book_title, b.isbn, e.name AS employee_name FROM Inventory_History h JOIN Book b ON h.book_id = b.book_id LEFT JOIN Employee e ON h.employee_id = e.employee_id WHERE h.book_id = #{book_id} ORDER BY h.history_id DESC
